QUOTE: A built-in allocator plugs into the same hook. `library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-576`, `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()`, carves allocations out of a caller-supplied static buffer. It does this by calling `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` itself, so it is one more client of the same substitution mechanism.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init function calls the setter, but it never says it is the only in-tree user. It calls it "one more client", and it also doesn't name MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C.
